verdict.rationale: Trivy's docs explicitly state built-in checks for Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CloudFormation and more IaC misconfigurations, and this is corroborated by CLI usage examples (e.g., trivy k8s) and hands-on probes confirming the scanner runs and produces actionable results with CI-friendly exit codes. Community feedback also independently praises Trivy's ease of CI/CD integration and broad scanning coverage. missing for 10: no direct hands-on probe specifically targeting a Terraform/K8s misconfiguration scan output (probe only covered fs vuln/secret scan).
